title: Micro-variational TS0 to TS1 pressure-dependent master equation
summary: Definitive pressure-dependent kinetics protocol: inverse-power long-range TS0 capture, explicit angular and partial-wave channel minimization, rovibrational state normalization, collisional energy/J transfer, and microcanonical TS1 product branching.
gates: Separated-fragment asymptote is fitted independently and never absorbed into C4 or C6
Crisci-Ballotta-Mendolicchio-Barone R^-4+R^-6 continuation is validated at withheld radial points
TS0 minimizes the weighted open-channel count over the radial dividing surface for every energy and J
Angular, partial-wave, rotational and vibrational weights are normalized exactly once
TS1 product flux is supplied as a microcanonical cumulative reaction probability and is not identified with capture
Energy and angular-momentum transfer use one reversible detailed-balance collision kernel
Master-equation conservation, chemical detailed balance and stationary residual gates pass
The protocol reports capture, return and product branching separately
VRC-VTST multidimensional Monte Carlo remains an explicitly declared future extension
coordinate_policy: The entrance coordinate is the intermolecular R with explicit angular channels; TS1 uses the validated ESALC-I reaction coordinate and shared rovibrational state origin.
backend_policy: Electronic fields are acquired upstream by the declared backend. Kinetic assembly is backend-neutral and consumes XYXIN-compatible state measures, inverse-power tails and microcanonical fluxes.
